release.content: pubrules 0.43.0 was released on 2026-11-17 from commit b6162f0e772ef6563a5eb366b940b90dfb4c013d with these changes.

rows: pubkit is now pubrules, at Sustenaut/pubrules: the package, the command and its module are pubrules, a repository's config is pubrules.json, the managed files are ./pubrules, pubrules.mk, pubrules-python.mk and tests/requirements-pubrules.txt, the environment variables are PUBRULES_*, and sync pins Sustenaut/pubrules/.github/workflows/... and Sustenaut/pubrules/actions/...; nothing reads the old names, so a repository moves over in one migration pull request
